Expanding its weighted squared prime-counting deviation gives a background term, a linear prime term, and a double prime-pair term. The background, linear contribution, and diagonal part of the pair term are evaluated. Under the stated parameter inequalities the remaining central off-diagonal contribution is positive, forcing primes p<q with q in a short interval above p.
